say:2:1530308001:0.text: That's not up to us. The soil decides what can grow here.
say:2:1530308001:0.source_cn: 这不是我们说了算的，我们现在需要弄明白这块地能种什么。
say:2:1530308001:0.male: That's not up to us. The soil decides what can grow here.
say:2:1530308001:0.female: That's not up to us. The soil decides what can grow here.

say:3:1530308002:0.text: We've already tried so many crops. Look at the fields now—dry and barren. It's hopeless.
say:3:1530308002:0.source_cn: 我们都试了多少作物了，要我说，田地都旱成这样了，肯定什...
say:3:1530308002:0.male: We've already tried so many crops. Look at the fields now—dry and barren. It's hopeless.
say:3:1530308002:0.female: We've already tried so many crops. Look at the fields now—dry and barren. It's hopeless.

say:4:1530308003:1.text: Might as well give up before we waste more strength!
say:4:1530308003:1.source_cn: 趁早放弃，还能省点力气！
say:4:1530308003:1.male: Might as well give up before we waste more strength!
say:4:1530308003:1.female: Might as well give up before we waste more strength!
